Description: Detected a Generic API Key, potentially exposing access to various services and sensitive operations.
Author: Antoni Lueddeke
Message:
ci: migrate-from-empty job — full migration chain on a clean Postgres (MAP-165)

pytest runs --no-migrations, so no CI job ever applied the migration chain.
New job migrate-from-empty (parallel to test and pip-audit, own postgres:15
service, job-level env copied verbatim from the test job) runs
'migrate --no-input' on an empty database, then 'migrate --check'.
Catches the 2026-06-24 duplicate CreateModel and the 2026-07-08
fresh-DB missing-table class on the PR instead of at deploy.

ci.yml only (develop PRs); not added to deploy.yml or the production
required contexts (owner ruling D1=A).

Description: Detected a Generic API Key, potentially exposing access to various services and sensitive operations.
Author: Antoni Lueddeke
Message:
Set HELCIM_* vars in ci.yml so pytest can boot

The HELCIM boot check in billing/apps.py (2026-06-02) runs inside
django.setup(), which pytest-django calls before conftest can inject
test values; ci.yml never set the four vars, so every PR into develop
failed at collection. Mirrors the deploy.yml test job.

Author: Antoni Lueddeke
Message:
fix(18-02): move helcim test env setup to root conftest pytest_configure

Description: Detected a Generic API Key, potentially exposing access to various services and sensitive operations.
Author: Antoni Lueddeke
Message:
refactor(10-03): split custom_auth/views.py into 5 domain modules (QA-03)

Moves all 9 view functions verbatim from the 911-line monolith into a
custom_auth/views/ package with domain-specific modules (D-04):

- oauth.py: google_exchange (AllowAny)
- registration.py: register_with_email (AllowAny)
- jwt_auth.py: get_jwt_token, refresh_jwt_token (AllowAny)
- profile.py: user_profile (IsAuthenticated), logout (AllowAny)
- password_reset.py: password_reset_request, password_reset_validate_token,
  password_reset_confirm (AllowAny)

__init__.py re-exports all 9 names so custom_auth/urls.py is unchanged (D-05).
Monolith deleted only after Docker pytest confirmed all 63 auth tests pass (D-06).

Also updates test mock patch paths from custom_auth.views.requests to
custom_auth.views.oauth.requests to match the new module location.

Full pytest suite: 195 passed (baseline unchanged).

Author: Antoni Lueddeke
Message:
Add comprehensive invoice system fixes and PDF generation

Features implemented:
- Invoice number auto-generation (INV-YYYY-MM-NNNN format)
- Automatic total_amount calculation for all invoices
- PDF generation service for teacher and student invoices
- Email delivery with multi-attachment support
- Student invoice auto-creation on teacher submission
- Password reset functionality with email tokens

Invoice system improvements:
- Fixed due_date calculation (14 days from submission)
- Fixed Decimal/float type conflicts in lesson calculations
- Added invoice ordering (newest first) in management view
- Restored PDF services from production branch

Technical changes:
- Added reportlab==4.0.7 for PDF generation
- Added billing/services/ module with PDF and email services
- Added invoice_number and total_amount fields to Invoice model
- Added lesson_type field with 'in_person' default
- Created migration 0010 for new invoice fields
- Added password reset endpoints and views
- Fixed logger import issues

Files modified:
- billing/models.py: Added invoice fields and Decimal handling
- billing/views.py: Invoice totals, PDF generation, ordering
- billing/services/: Complete PDF generation system
- custom_auth/: Password reset endpoints
- requirements.txt: Added reportlab
